jtbd.jtbd_title: Crisis triage, honest assessment, and admissions positioning
jtbd.jtbd_desc: Stabilize execution during personal crisis; prune commitments; articulate authentic positioning for admissions fit.

interactions.user_ask: How do I keep moving without burning out during this crisis?
interactions.jenny_reply: Cut scope to the bone: school + SAT vitals + one EC you love. Everything else pauses for two weeks.

interactions.user_ask: How should I talk about this in apps?
interactions.jenny_reply: Name the constraint, show the adjustment you made, and point to the signal that still shipped.

outcomes.name: two_week_scope_freeze
outcomes.details: Only school, SAT vitals (3 quality reps), one EC micro‑artifact/week.

outcomes.name: authentic_positioning_note
outcomes.details: Draft note on values: resilience, service, proof-over-prose.
